name: validate-advanced-build
description: Validates that advanced build features work correctly across multiple feature flag combinations. Tests cargo check, cargo test, and cargo clippy with different feature combinations to identify compatibility issues.
author: cargo-cicd

documentation.summary: Multi-feature flag validation for advanced Rust builds
documentation.purpose: Ensures advanced features and their combinations build, test, and lint without errors. Identifies which feature combinations are compatible and which have conflicts.
documentation.target_audience: Developers working with advanced features in cargo-cicd

quick.description: Skip clippy validation to speed up checks (useful for rapid iteration)

verbose.description: Show full command output including compiler warnings and all test output

fix.description: Attempt to automatically fix detected issues (e.g., clippy warnings with --fix)

columns.name: Issues
columns.description: Summary of any errors or warnings found

pass.meaning: The validation step completed successfully without errors or denying warnings

fail.meaning: The validation step failed with errors (compilation errors, test failures, or clippy denials)

skip.meaning: The validation step was skipped (e.g., due to --quick flag)

compatible.meaning: All enabled validation steps passed for this feature combination

incompatible.meaning: One or more validation steps failed, indicating feature conflicts or breakage

partial.meaning: Some steps passed and some were skipped (e.g., --quick mode); full validation not completed

report_sections.name: Compatibility Matrix
report_sections.content: Table showing pass/fail for each combination and validation step

report_sections.name: Detailed Results
report_sections.content: For each failed combination, show error output and affected dependency chain

report_sections.name: Recommendations
content: Which combinations to use in production
Feature interactions to be aware of

report_sections.name: Verbose Output (if requested)
report_sections.content: Full compiler output, test logs, and clippy warnings for all steps

example_1.expected_behavior: Runs only cargo check for each combination, no clippy or tests, completes in ~1-2 minutes

example_2.expected_behavior: Runs all validations (check, test, clippy) for each combination, ~5-10 minutes

example_3.scenario: Auto-fix clippy issues and show details
example_3.expected_behavior: Runs all validations with detailed output, attempts to auto-fix clippy warnings

build_failure.cause: Compilation error in a feature combination
build_failure.action: Report feature conflict, show conflicting dependencies or incompatible code paths
build_failure.next_steps: Review conditional compilation blocks and feature flags

test_failure.cause: Unit test failures with a specific feature combination
test_failure.action: Show failing test output and feature context

clippy_denial.action: List denied warnings and their locations
clippy_denial.next_steps: Use --fix flag to auto-correct, or review warnings manually

timeout.action: Report which step timed out and feature combination
timeout.next_steps: May indicate infinite loop or very slow compilation; investigate build times

rules.rule: Steps skipped (--quick) and remaining steps pass

feature_dependency_graph.description: How features depend on each other (from Cargo.toml)
